translations.web: Also the hand of God came on Judah to give them one heart, to do the commandment of the king and of the princes by Yahweh’s word.
translations.bsb: Moreover, the power of God was on the people in Judah to give them one heart to obey the command of the king and his officials according to the word of the LORD.
translations.kjv: Also in Judah the hand of God was to give them one heart to do the commandment of the king and of the princes, by the word of the LORD.
translations.asv: Also upon Judah came the hand of God to give them one heart, to do the commandment of the king and of the princes by the word of Jehovah.
